test_case.name: Service Routes Traffic to Unhealthy Pods (publishNotReadyAddresses Enabled)
test_case.scenario_description: Pod 'checkout-gateway-4e5f6a7b8-r9m1c' (container 'checkout-proxy', namespace 'payments') is failing its readiness checks because its local payment encryption HSM session is disconnected. However, Service 'checkout-gateway-svc' has 'publishNotReadyAddresses: true' set in its spec, forcing Kubernetes EndpointSlices to keep advertising the unready pod IP (10.244.4.91) as an active backend and routing live customer checkout traffic to the broken pod.
test_case.injected_fault: Service 'checkout-gateway-svc' configured with spec.publishNotReadyAddresses: true, causing EndpointSlices and kube-proxy to route live traffic to unready pod 'checkout-gateway-4e5f6a7b8-r9m1c'.
test_case.ground_truth_rca: Service 'checkout-gateway-svc' in namespace 'payments' is routing live traffic to unhealthy/unready pod 'checkout-gateway-4e5f6a7b8-r9m1c' (10.244.4.91) because 'publishNotReadyAddresses: true' is enabled on the Service, bypassing readiness gating and causing HTTP 502/503 checkout failures.
